title: Loan Application API System
summary: A secure Laravel API for loan applications with weekly repayment schedules, approval workflows and repayment tracking.
result: Secure loan application and weekly repayment workflow
challenge: The system needed authenticated loan applications, structured weekly repayment terms and straightforward repayment tracking.
solution: Built authenticated endpoints for loan applications.
Structured approved loans around weekly repayments.
Added a simplified endpoint for submitting weekly repayments.
Focused on reliable processing and repayment tracking.
outcomes: Delivered a complete loan application API workflow.
Kept authenticated interactions secure and straightforward.
